title: Redesign Leave Application Input Section with 3-Column CSS Grid Layout

requirements.summary: Redesign the Input Section of LeaveApplicationPage.tsx to use a CSS grid layout with 3 columns arranged in exactly 4 rows as specified, without changing any form field functionality, values, state, or handlers
acceptanceCriteria: The input section renders fields in a 3-column grid on screens 768px and wider.
Row 1 contains: Recipient Type, Language, Your Name (left to right).
Row 2 contains: Parent/Guardian Name, School/College Name, Class/Grade (left to right).
Row 3 contains: Leave Date(s), Leave Duration Type, Reason for Leave (left to right).
Row 4 contains: Absent Since (Date) in column 1, Medical Certificate Checkbox in column 2, and an empty/invisible placeholder in column 3.
No field spans more than one grid column unless it was already spanning the full width intentionally.
All form functionality (state, handlers, validation, submission) remains unchanged.

file_operations.description: Restructure the Input Section form fields to use CSS grid layout with `display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 16px;`. Arrange fields into 4 rows: Row 1 (Recipient Type, Language, Your Name), Row 2 (Parent/Guardian Name, School/College Name, Class/Grade), Row 3 (Leave Date(s), Leave Duration Type, Reason for Leave), Row 4 (Absent Since Date, Medical Certificate Checkbox, empty placeholder div). Keep all existing state variables, handlers, validation logic, and submission flow unchanged. Only modify the JSX structure and CSS classes to implement the grid layout.

requirements.summary: Remove full-width input styling from all fields in the Input Section so each input, select, and checkbox group respects its grid cell width
acceptanceCriteria: No input or select element in the Input Section has inline or Tailwind `w-full` / `width: 100%` styles that exceed the grid cell boundary.
All text inputs and dropdowns are visually the same width within their respective grid columns.
The layout appears compact and professional with no inputs overflowing their cells.

file_operations.description: Remove `w-full` or `width: 100%` classes from all input elements, select dropdowns, and form controls within the Input Section grid. Replace with appropriate width constraints that respect the grid cell boundaries. Ensure all text inputs and select elements have consistent visual width within their respective grid columns.

requirements.summary: Add a responsive breakpoint to the Input Section grid so it switches to a single-column layout on screens below 768px
acceptanceCriteria: On viewports ≥ 768px, the Input Section renders 3 columns.
On viewports < 768px, the Input Section collapses to a single column with all fields stacked vertically.
The responsive behavior is implemented using a CSS media query or Tailwind responsive prefix (e.g., `sm:grid-cols-3`).

file_operations.description: Add responsive Tailwind classes to the Input Section grid container: use `grid-cols-1` as the base (mobile-first) and `md:grid-cols-3` for viewports 768px and wider. This ensures the grid collapses to a single column on mobile devices while maintaining the 3-column layout on larger screens.

requirements.summary: Fix the spacing between the Input Section card and the Output Section by removing unnecessary margins and padding to achieve balanced vertical rhythm
acceptanceCriteria: The gap between the Input Section card and the Output Section is visually balanced and not excessive.
The Input card has no large bottom margin or padding that was previously used to account for a taller input layout.
The output action buttons (Copy, Download PDF, etc.) sit near the bottom edge of the output card with minimal extra padding below them.
The page does not show large blank areas between the two sections on desktop or mobile.

file_operations.description: Review and adjust vertical spacing classes on the Input Section Card component and Output Section container. Remove excessive `mb-*` (margin-bottom) classes from the Input card wrapper. Reduce padding below the output action buttons container to ensure they sit close to the bottom edge of the output card. Adjust the gap between the two sections to achieve balanced vertical rhythm without large blank areas.
